name: nitwit
revision: r2 (2026-11-11): the owner's Review Room notes (2026-11-10): an acted Gemini voice (Pip) with the ending given room; Fernbank's real terrain (no superflat)
caption: the nitwit finally said something 😳
premise: The village nitwit only ever says 'hmm'. He always stands exactly where something bad is about to happen (a tree before lightning, the wheat before a creeper, the well before it turns to lava), and every other villager walks away from him. The narrator follows him one night past the last torch and finds a burned, empty copy of his own village.
twist: The nitwit is from a world that already ended, sent back to warn this one, and 'hmm' is all the game lets a nitwit say. Today he stands right next to the narrator: the bad thing is about to happen to him. He says the date of the end, and it's today.

world.where: Fernbank (map.json fernbank) and the Burned Copy past the last torch (burned_copy)

N.on_screen: POV (hand and hotbar), default Steve skin

lines.text: The NITWIT / in my village / has said HMM / 4,096 TIMES.
lines.say: The nitwit in my village has said hmm four thousand and ninety-six TIMES.

lines.text: Under a TREE. / That night, / LIGHTNING / split it.
lines.say: Under a TREE. That night, LIGHTNING split it.

lines.text: In the WHEAT. / A CREEPER / walked in / and BOOM.
lines.say: In the WHEAT. A creeper walked in and BOOM.

lines.text: By the WELL. / The water / turned to / LAVA.
lines.say: By the WELL. The water turned to LAVA.

lines.text: On MY roof. / The next day, / it rained / ANVILS.
lines.say: On MY roof. The next day, it rained ANVILS.

lines.text: The other / villagers / WALK AWAY / when he comes.
lines.say: The other villagers walk AWAY when he comes.

lines.text: Even the / IRON GOLEM / goes AROUND him.
lines.say: Even the iron golem goes AROUND him.

lines.text: So one night, / I FOLLOWED him.
lines.say: So one night, I FOLLOWED him.

lines.text: Past the / last torch / was ANOTHER / village.
lines.say: Past the last torch was ANOTHER village.

lines.text: The TREE. / The WHEAT. / The WELL. / All GONE.
lines.say: The TREE. The WHEAT. The WELL. All GONE.

lines.text: He's not / FROM here. / His world / already ENDED.
lines.say: He's not FROM here. His world already ENDED.

lines.text: They sent him / BACK / to WARN us.
lines.say: They sent him back to WARN us.

lines.text: But a NITWIT / can only / say one word.
lines.say: But a NITWIT can only say one word.

lines.text: And today, / he's standing / right next / to ME.
lines.say: And today, he's standing right next to ME.

lines.text: He said / my NAME. / Then the DATE / of the END.
lines.say: He said my NAME. Then the date of the END.

lines.note: the owner: 'need the voice to be better'. Its own beat, its own take, room before it

requests.direction: [A bubbly nine-year-old kid, fast, bright and energetic, telling a friend an amazing story; not whispery, breathy or soft]
[A nine-year-old kid, the moment it sinks in, slower and clear; not whispery or soft]
